eyebrow.zh: 把省略的事项、理由、文件与会话记录到本地台账，供审阅者决定哪些需要重新处理。
eyebrow.en: Record skipped items, reasons, files and sessions in a local ledger so reviewers can decide what needs another pass.

headline.zh: 让被省略的工作留下理由。
headline.en: Keep a reason for omitted work.

sub.zh: 把省略的事项、理由、文件与会话记录到本地台账，供审阅者决定哪些需要重新处理。
sub.en: Record skipped items, reasons, files and sessions in a local ledger so reviewers can decide what needs another pass.

caption.zh: 图示展示组件关系；实际输出见下方示例。
caption.en: An illustrative component scene; recorded output appears below.

body.en: Keep the item and reason together.

body.zh: 文件、类别与会话可查询。
body.en: File, category and session remain queryable.

body.zh: reopen 留下再次处理的备注。
审阅一次 Agent 修改时，已经写出的内容容易看到，主动没做的部分却常常消失。OmitLedger 让调用方在做出省略决定时记录事项和自述理由，随后通过列表和 reopen 形成可追踪的复核动作。
body.en: During review, completed changes are visible while deliberately omitted work can disappear. OmitLedger lets a caller record the item and stated reason at the time of omission, then use list and reopen to make follow-up review traceable.

body.zh: 完整 shell 脚本创建临时台账，记录一条合成省略、查看列表、reopen 后再次查看。ID 随运行生成。
body.en: A complete shell script creates a temporary ledger, records one synthetic omission, lists it, reopens it and lists it again. IDs are generated on each run.

alt.zh: 完整 shell 脚本创建临时台账，记录一条合成省略、查看列表、reopen 后再次查看。ID 随运行生成。
alt.en: A complete shell script creates a temporary ledger, records one synthetic omission, lists it, reopens it and lists it again. IDs are generated on each run.

body.zh: Cobra CLI 把 add/list/reopen 映射到 ledger.Store。SQLite 保存 Omission 的类别、目标文件、会话、状态与复核备注。reopen 更新台账状态，不会自动执行被省略的任务；当前命令入口中的 mcp 与 report 仍为占位。
body.en: The Cobra CLI maps add/list/reopen to ledger.Store. SQLite stores an Omission’s category, target file, session, status and review note. reopen updates ledger state; it does not execute omitted work. The current mcp and report command entry points remain placeholders.

alt.en: The Cobra CLI maps add/list/reopen to ledger.Store. SQLite stores an Omission’s category, target file, session, status and review note. reopen updates ledger state; it does not execute omitted work. The current mcp and report command entry points remain placeholders.

body.zh: 可以在 Agent 工作流中显式调用 CLI，也可参考自带的技能片段。它依赖调用方主动记录，不会扫描代码推断遗漏，也不判断理由是否合理。
body.en: Workflows can explicitly call the CLI or use the supplied skill snippet as guidance. Recording is cooperative: it does not infer omissions from code or decide whether a reason is justified.

body.zh: 台账位置优先级：`--store` > `OMITLEDGER_STORE` > `.omitledger/ledger.db`。会话优先读取 `OMITLEDGER_SESSION`、CLAUDE_SESSION_ID、CURSOR_SESSION_ID，最终回退 local。SQLite 使用 WAL 与 5000ms busy timeout。
body.en: Ledger location precedence is `--store` > `OMITLEDGER_STORE` > `.omitledger/ledger.db`. Session precedence is `OMITLEDGER_SESSION`, CLAUDE_SESSION_ID, CURSOR_SESSION_ID, then local. SQLite uses WAL and a 5000ms busy timeout.

body.zh: 同一事项从 open 变为 reopened，备注要求覆盖重试分支。
body.en: The same item moves from open to reopened with a note requesting retry-branch coverage.

body.zh: 需要 Go 1.24+。使用纯 Go SQLite 驱动。下方脚本只操作临时数据库，不修改被提及的 retry.go。
body.en: Requires Go 1.24+ and uses a pure-Go SQLite driver. The script operates only on a temporary database and does not change the referenced retry.go.

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/omitledger.git
cd omitledger
go build -o bin/omitledger ./cmd/omitledger

limitations.zh: 记录是调用方自述；缺少条目不表示没有遗漏，reopened 不表示工作已完成。
limitations.en: Records are caller statements: missing entries do not establish absence of omissions, and reopened does not mean completed.

limitations.zh: 当前 mcp/report 占位命令会成功返回，但没有提供其描述的完整功能。
limitations.en: The current mcp/report placeholders can exit successfully without providing the described full functionality.
